newsitem.title: HUNGARY: BUDAPEST AIRPORT CARGO IMPORTS DELAYED OVER RULES.
newsitem.headline: BUDAPEST AIRPORT CARGO IMPORTS DELAYED OVER RULES.

text.p: Regulations that took effect on Monday have started delaying the customs clearance of cargo imported to Ferihegy Airport in Budapest, airlines and freight forwarders said.
"Hopefully, it's only a 24-hour delay," Laszlo Lencz, airfreight manager of freight forwarder Cargoline, told Reuters.
"The new regulations require the customs authorities to obtain more detailed registrations of imported cargo, and that means more paperwork," Lencz added.
Some airport officials blamed the delays on Hungary's customs authorities, saying the airport customs offices were inadequately equipped and staffed for the new regulations.
